---
description: Verify an adventure before publication.
---

Review the selected adventure and its rubric.

Check:

- one clear agentic learning objective;
- correct Ask → Plan → Agent → Review → Evidence progression;
- current official GitHub or Microsoft references;
- stable versus preview labeling;
- valid internal links;
- deterministic evidence and reset steps;
- meaningful image alt text;
- no secrets, fabricated output, or unsupported performance claims.

Run the smallest relevant repository checks and return a concise publication report.
